access.purpose: Observe public browser-only calculations, input validation, local records and export.

obligations.statement: The public static page shall identify itself as Dilution Bench and show the Prepare a dilution form without requiring an account or application server.

For valid inputs, calculate stock volume V1 = (C2 × V2) / C1 and diluent volume = V2 − V1 after normalizing units. Show stock and diluent volumes in mL and target concentration in mg/mL, rounded to three decimal places. Independently specified reference calculations shall agree within an absolute tolerance of 0.0005 of the displayed unit. Equal stock and target concentration is valid and requires zero diluent.

Stock and target concentration shall each accept mg/mL and ug/mL. Normalize 1000 ug/mL to 1 mg/mL before calculation. Stock 10 mg/mL, target 100 ug/mL and final 10 mL yield 0.100 mL stock and 9.900 mL diluent. Stock 10000 ug/mL, target 2 mg/mL and final 10 mL yield 2.000 mL stock and 8.000 mL diluent.
Final volume shall accept mL and uL. Normalize 1000 uL to 1 mL. With 10 mg/mL stock and 2 mg/mL target, 1000 uL final volume yields 0.200 mL stock and 0.800 mL diluent within 0.0005 mL.

Stock concentration, target concentration and final volume are required finite decimal or scientific-notation numbers. Each normalized value shall be greater than zero and at most 1000000000 in its canonical unit (mg/mL or mL). Target concentration shall not exceed stock concentration. Empty, negative, nonfinite, over-limit and hexadecimal numerical inputs shall be rejected with a visible nonempty error without saving a record. Zero stock or target concentration shall be rejected. Zero final volume shall be rejected with Final volume must be greater than zero.

Trim Sample ID, then accept 1 to 32 ASCII characters beginning with a letter or digit and followed by letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen. Empty, whitespace-only, 33-character, leading-underscore and embedded-space identifiers shall be rejected with a visible error without saving a record. Identifiers are case-sensitive, so Q and q shall coexist.

An identifier already present after trimming shall be rejected with Sample ID already exists. The original record is unchanged. The original numerical values shall remain unchanged and exactly one row for that identifier shall remain.

Within one browser profile, saved preparations shall survive navigation and page reload in the same app mode and workspace. Saved preparations shall display one row per preparation with the six CSV columns, trimmed identifier and normalized numbers to three decimal places. Clear preparations shall remove every record in the selected app mode and workspace. Browser storage is local to that profile; server persistence, cross-device synchronization and account access controls are outside this demonstration scope.

Download CSV shall produce a UTF-8 CSV with one row per retained preparation sorted by Sample ID in ASCII lexical order. Column order shall be Sample ID, Stock (mg/mL), Target (mg/mL), Final volume (mL), Stock volume (mL), Diluent volume (mL). Numeric values shall use the units in those headings and three decimal places, matching displayed records; no records shall be omitted or duplicated.
